panels.title: Gateway — Location
panels.description: Last known GNSS fix per gateway (stationary install; reported at boot and rarely afterwards, independent of the dashboard time range).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gw_location")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["gw"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "lat", "lon", "accuracy_m", "gw"])

panels.title: GPS — Fix Valid
panels.description: 1 = fix obtained, 0 = attempt failed/timed out. Published on every attempt (not just successes).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gw_location" and r._field == "fix_valid")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "gw"])

panels.title: GPS — Satellites tracked vs used
panels.description: Tracked = carrier lock acquired. Used = fully decoded ephemeris, actually usable for a fix. A gap between the two means signal is present but not for long enough continuously.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gw_location" and (r._field == "satellites_tracked" or r._field == "satellites_used"))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "gw"])

panels.title: GPS — Attempt duration
panels.description: Elapsed GNSS runtime for the attempt (includes any time blocked by LTE).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gw_location" and r._field == "elapsed_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "gw"])
